cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining ether sulfate (SLES 2) plus prominent reinforcing ether sulfates (Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate 14, Magnesium Laureth Sulfate 16, Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate 17, Sodium Oleth Sulfate 19, Magnesium Oleth Sulfate 20) -> strong by convention.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: The reinforcing ether sulfates are late (after Glycerin 13) and look like one mild magnesium/laureth-8 blend at low level; three buffers (3, 5, 6) and refatting (7). Realistic reading could be moderate; convention keeps strong, confidence moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: no cationic polymer, silicone or payload lipid; only Glyceryl Oleate (7), Panthenol (10), Glycerin (13), Glycol Distearate (15) and Hydrogenated Vegetable Glycerides Citrate (22). Little substantive slip.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Refatter plus pearlizer give some softness; not a substantive system.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: only weak refatters; no cationic, silicone, lipid or film deposition; strong reset.
